name: Hot soy milk
summary: Sweet hot soy milk in a cup, the drink to carry through the night market when the air turns cold.
origin: An evening drink at the Da Lat market and the night market, for the cool air.
howToEat: Take a cup after dark, when the air cools, and walk with it.
where: Da Lat Market and the night market in the centre, and 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ. The night stalls run about 18:00–23:00.
priceBand: About 10,000 VND at 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ (Visit Lâm Đồng food-tour note).
seoTitle: Hot soy milk — Da Lat night market
seoDescription: Sweet hot soy milk in a cup, the drink to carry through the night market when the air turns cold.
